_comment: State Election Signal: results of state elections held after GE15, used
as a leading indicator into the Swing Model (CONTEXT.md).
Maintained by hand — state elections are occasional events, not a feed.
Add a new entry when one is held; the Swing Model measures each result
against the GE15 Baseline shares of that same state's Seats.
Vote shares are fractions of the valid vote and need not sum to 1: a
Coalition the result does not report is read as having no observed swing.
Malacca's 2026 election is due on or before November 2026 and had not
been held as of 6 August 2026, so there is no entry for it yet.
